name: robots/edvardsz__ur5_gym
title: UR5/RG2 Reach (Ignition Gazebo simulation)
intro: UR5/RG2 Reach (Ignition Gazebo simulation), adapted from edvardsz/ur5_gym. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `reset_world`, `seed_world` and `step`. `reset_world`: reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/edvardsz__ur5_gym --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/edvardsz__ur5_gym --backend fake --mcp
